caption: The drawing depicts a marionette puppet suspended by five green strings attached to its hands, shoulders, and head. The marionette has a carved wooden face with exaggerated features, including arched black eyebrows, a mustache, and an open mouth showing teeth. The puppet wears a long, loose-fitting robe that has an ornate, multicolored design with floral and paisley patterns predominantly in red, blue, green, and gold on a white background. The edges of the robe are trimmed with a green and gold border, and the hemline is jagged with pointed tips. Each hand holds a small golden bell. The marionette’s right leg is partially exposed, showing a wooden structure, and it wears mismatched shoes: the left shoe is black with a white sole, and the right shoe is partially covered by the robe. There is a long, dark braid hanging from the puppet’s head, over the right shoulder. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Puppet - "Chinese Minstrel"
